project_type: Vite + React SPA with Node.js Express backend and Supabase PostgreSQL
build_system: Vite with terser minification, npm scripts
test_command: Manual verification: npm run dev and test features
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build and check for console errors. 2. Run npm audit to check vulnerabilities reduced. 3. Test admin login, report submission, map loading. 4. Verify SQL scripts in Supabase SQL Editor before applying to production.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ directory from npm run build (not checked in)
environment_constraints: Never commit .env file. Service role key must stay server-side only. KloudTech token stored in localStorage is acceptable (third-party API token, not auth token). Supabase anon key is public by design. Mapbox token is public by design.
contribution_requirements: Autonomous execution per AGENTS.md - run commands directly without asking. Use logger.js for all console statements. Validate all file uploads with fileValidator.js. Database changes must be tested in Supabase SQL Editor with rollback plan.
key_patterns: Logger wrapper exists (src/lib/logger.js) and suppresses console in production. File validator exists (src/lib/fileValidator.js) with MIME and extension checks. Security utilities exist (src/lib/security.js) with sanitizeInput, rate limiters, password validation. DOMPurify used in ReportCard.jsx. React.lazy used for MapScreen, AdminDashboard, AdminMapScreen, AdminLogin. Images use loading='lazy'. Express server.js has rate limiting (100/15min global, 5/15min auth). Supabase client uses env vars correctly. Vite config drops console in production build.
directory_structure: src/components (UI + dashboard + layout + map + ui), src/context (ThemeContext), src/hooks (pagination hooks), src/lib (logger, fileValidator, security, supabase, utils), src/screens (Admin*, Auth*, Home, Map, Profile, Emergency, etc), src/services (kloudtechService), server.js (Express backend), public (static assets, tourism data)
